Home.heroDesc: A public life dedicated to the progress of Adoor Assembly Constituency. Fostering leadership, transparency, and citizen-first service.
Home.aboutTitle: A Public Life. A Commitment to Adoor.
Home.aboutDesc: Born in Konni, Adv. CV Santhakumar has dedicated his life to public service. An advocate by profession and a leader by action, he represents the Indian National Congress. In the 2026 Assembly elections, the people of Adoor placed their trust in him to lead the constituency into a new era of development.
Home.milestone1Desc: Spearheaded the initiative to revitalize rural roads and improve connectivity across the Adoor constituency.
Home.milestone2Desc: Played a critical role in energising youth participation in public policy and democratic processes across the district.
Home.milestone3Desc: A strong voice in the assembly advocating for the rights of farmers and working-class citizens in Pathanamthitta.
Home.voiceDesc: A next-generation digital public office for Adoor. Access services, raise grievances, and connect with your representative directly.

About.title: A Public Life. A Commitment to Adoor.
About.desc: Adv. CV Santhakumar is an Indian politician and advocate serving as the Member of the Kerala Legislative Assembly for the Adoor constituency since 2026. Rooted in Konni and committed to the progress of Pathanamthitta, his journey is defined by grassroots leadership and public service.
About.timelineDesc1: Born to Vasu in Konni, Pathanamthitta district, Kerala.
About.timelineDesc2: Graduated with a BA from a college affiliated with the University of Calicut.
About.timelineDesc3: Completed a 5-year integrated law degree at Government Law College, Thrissur. Enrolled as an advocate.
About.timelineDesc4: Selected to represent the Indian National Congress (INC) in the Adoor Assembly constituency.
About.timelineDesc5: Won the election with 66,153 votes, securing a majority of 10,332 votes to become the MLA for Adoor.
About.rootsDesc: Born in Konni, Adv. CV Santhakumar comes from a background deeply connected to the land and the people. His upbringing in a socially conscious family laid the foundation for his commitment to public welfare.
